_about: Art styles: movements and long-dead artists only (public domain), drawn by our own code in templates/styles/<id>.js. One card per style in this folder (<id>.md). Ratings are about OUR implementation: 3 = recognisable at a glance, ready; 2 = usable, read the weaknesses; 1 = experimental.

bauhaus.name: Bauhaus
bauhaus.goodFor: product launches, design and architecture, data, anything that wants order and confidence

van-gogh.name: Van Gogh night sky
van-gogh.goodFor: stories, launches with a dreamy or romantic tone, night/sleep/space products, art and culture

constructivism.name: Russian Constructivism
constructivism.goodFor: announcements, calls to action, launches with urgency, protest-energy campaigns, bold data claims

matisse.name: Matisse paper cut-outs
matisse.goodFor: joyful brands, culture and education, kids and family, summer campaigns, anything that wants warmth and rhythm

seurat.name: Seurat pointillism
seurat.goodFor: leisure, travel, outdoors, slow and luminous moods, premium lifestyle

ukiyo-e.name: Ukiyo-e woodblock print
ukiyo-e.goodFor: travel, Japan-related subjects, craft and heritage brands, calm-but-dramatic stories, ocean/water topics
